Subject: BrightCart discovery recap & next steps

Hi Ana / Derek — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a clean list of open items and proposed next steps: 

What we heard
- BrightCart needs predictable low-latency inference for checkout recommendation flows (95th percentile < 90ms)
- Strong requirement for data isolation and audit logs for payments data
- Pilot target: 100k monthly requests, ramp to 1M over 6 months

Open questions
- Can you confirm where inference will run (GCP us-west vs. BrightCart VPC)?
- Any specific compliance docs procurement needs before a pilot?

Proposed next steps (to unblock pilot)
1) Technical deep dive (30–45m) — infra + perf runbook, KV cache strategy, quantization tradeoffs.
2) Executive alignment (VP/CTO handshake) — high-level SLA, rollout cadence, commercial runway.

We can do the technical deep dive as early as this Wed or Thu (May 19 or 20) — suggested times: 10:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT. For the exec handshake, would you prefer a separate short slot the following week?

Attaching my quick call-notes: call-notes-20270517.txt

If you confirm preferred times and anyone else to include (security/procurement), I will lock invites and share a short mutual action plan and prep deck.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
